note: Alcona County (MI, 26001) publishes parcels only through its Beacon/Schneider viewer, a proprietary web app (bot-check HTTP 403 on fetch) with no public ArcGIS REST parcel service. The only public ArcGIS parcel layer found (Parcels_Alcona_Twp, 2,972 features, third-party owned) covers Alcona Township only and returns zero parcels for the validation area around -83.58348,44.68426. Other sources are paid vendor downloads (Regrid, Dynamo, Reportall, MappingSolutionsGIS).
